decisions.reason: This series is tightly aligned with the firm's core curation and label capabilities, offers learning across several variants, and is cheap to keep open in an online long-tail catalog.
A jazz vinyl reissue fits the firm's genre-broadening strategy and established reissue skills, so with no clear negative signal it remains a worthwhile option to continue offering.

The box set is more capital-intensive and niche than the other items, but it is still close to the firm's specialist physical-media offer, so management would more likely retain it unless sales clearly disappoint.
A compilation CD is close to the firm's existing business and inexpensive to carry in the catalog, making it rational to keep the option open while it continues to support breadth of offer.
